verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਕੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨ ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: saadh sa(n)g dhirasaT dharas kai braham dhiaan soiee tau asaadh sa(n)g dhirasaT bikaar hai ||

en.bdb: When the vision rests on the congregation of holy people, one's consciousness attaches with the Lord. The same vision turns into vices in the company of self-willed people.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਾਦ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: saadh sa(n)g sabadh surat kai braham giaan soiee tau asaadh sa(n)g baadh aha(n)kaar hai ||

en.bdb: In the holy company, one realises the Lord through the union of the True Guru's words and the consciousness. But the same consciousness becomes a cause of arrogance and discord in the company of ill reputed persons.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਕੈ ਮਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦ ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਖਮ ਅਹਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: saadh sa(n)g asan basan kai mahaa prasaadh soiee tau asaadh sa(n)g bikham ahaar hai ||

en.bdb: By virtue of the company of Guru-conscious persons simplicity in life and eating becomes supreme blessing. But eating (of meat etc.) in the company of ill-famed and self-willed people become painful and distressing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰ ਹੈ ॥੧੭੫॥
verses.translit_en: dhuramat janam maran hui asaadh sa(n)g gurmat saadh sa(n)g mukat dhuaar hai ||175||

en.bdb: Due to base wisdom, the company of the self-willed people become a cause of birth and death repeatedly. On the contrary, adopting Guru's wisdom and keeping company of holy persons become a cause of emancipation. (175)
